covenants.text: Permit the Leverage Ratio to be greater than 0.60 to 1.00 as of the end of any fiscal quarter.
Permit the Fixed Charge Coverage Ratio to be less than 1.50 to 1.00 as of the end of any fiscal quarter.
Permit the Consolidated Tangible Net Worth to be less than $7,000,000,000 as of the end of any fiscal quarter. 7.11 Sanctions .
Permit the Fixed Charge Coverage Ratio, as of the end of each fiscal quarter of the Borrower, to be less than 1.75 to 1.0.
Permit the Consolidated Tangible Net Worth to be, at any time, less than (i) $1,300,000,000 plus (ii) 90% of the Net Cash Proceeds from all Public Equity Issuances subsequent to the Closing Date.
